title: Endless Views | KEY.co
description_expanded: This thoughtfully designed coastal retreat delivers an elevated vacation experience with every detail curated for relaxation, fun, and style. With a private heated pool, a vibrant game room, and a rooftop patio offering sweeping Gulf views, the home invites effortless indoor-outdoor living. Deeded beach access is just a short stroll away, making it easy to shift from poolside lounging to sandy shoreline adventures. A spacious layout, including five beautifully appointed bedrooms, ensures comfort and privacy for families or groups to unwind in style. Exploration is part of the charm, with a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes ready for morning coffee runs or evening rides to nearby restaurants and shops. Inside, airy living spaces blend modern design with warm coastal accents, creating an inviting atmosphere for connection and rest. Whether gathering for sunset cocktails on the rooftop, enjoying a game night indoors, or savouring a quiet morning in the master suite, this home promises a seamless blend of luxury and laid-back beach living.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
